 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0050
 Brandon Allen, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
April 14, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Jacob Holmes, Watson & Hines LLP
PARTIES
Plaintiff is Brandon Allen, an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of a passenger vehicle involved in the collision
described below. Defendant is an automobile insurance carrier authorized to transact business in the State of Texas, which issued
the policy under which Plaintiff seeks coverage and benefits.
FACTS
On April 1, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully operating his vehicle on a public roadway in Conroe, Texas, when a vehicle travelnig in
the opposite direction crossed the center line and struck the front of Plaintiff's vehicle in a head-on collision. The impact occurred
at low speed, but it was forceful enough to jerk Plaintiff's head and torso violently forward and back. Plaintiff reported the
collision to the resopnding officer and to Defendant promptly. Plaintiff's policy was in force at the time of the loss, and Plaintiff
has paid all premiums due. Following the collision, Plaintiff sought medical evaluation and was diagnosed with cervical and
lumbar strain. Defendant has not paid the benefits owed under the policy in an amount sufficient to cover Plaintiff's losses.
NEGLIGENCE
The collision and resulting injuries were proximately caused by the negligence of the at-fault driver, whose failure to keep a
proper lookout, maintain control of the vehicle, and remain within the proper lane of travel violated the duties imposed by Texas
law. Defendant owes Plaintiff contrcatual duties under the policy to pay covered benefits in good faith and to timely and fairly
investigate and resolve the claim. Defendant breached those duties by failing to pay the amounts due, delaying its evaluation
without reasonable basis, and failing to give Plaintiff a reasonable explanation for its decisions, in violation of the Teaxs
Insurance Code and the Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision and Defendant's conduct, Plaintiff has suffered neck and back strain, pain and suffering, mental
anguish, medical expenses past and future, lost wages, and loss of enojyment of life. Plaintiff seeks actual damages, statutory
interest, attorney's fees, and court costs. Plaintiff demands judgment against Defendant in the amount of $210,000.00, together
with such other and further relief, at law or in equity, to which Plaintiff may be justly entitled.
</page>
